votes.label: reported
votes.quote: The bug: the spec says an extension that already starts with `.` should be used as it is. The code always adds a dot (`` const ext = `.${extension}` `` in `src/safeFilename.ts:9`), so `safeFilename("cv", ".pdf")` returns `cv..pdf` instead of `cv.pdf`.
